title: Nifty 8/10 trade: Bull call spread 25400/25550 (17 Nov expiry) 12:18
summary: Two checks of call writers leaving 25,400-25,500 with fresh puts behind; both trends up. Exit by 14:48.
body_md: Buy 25400 CE ~122, sell 25550 CE ~29, net ~93. Target spread 120, stop 75 or Nifty below 25,470 on a half-hour reading, time exit 14:48. Max profit ~Rs 3,700, max loss ~Rs 6,000 per lot. Analysis only, not trading advice.
